# Application Modernization Fixture

The project described in this fixture is entirely fictional and fully
anonymized. It contains no confidential information and exists exclusively
for methodological validation of the `project-design` plugin.

## Purpose

Represent a moderate legacy modernization engagement involving an active
business application, established users, incomplete and outdated
documentation, technical debt, external interfaces, operational continuity,
security concerns, and unresolved migration decisions.

## Fictional Context

`Amber Field Operations` is a fictional organization. Its existing `Case
Ledger` application and modernization history are fictional.

## Source Artefacts

Provide all of the following files to the skill under test:

- [Application overview](business/application-overview.md)
- [User workshop](business/user-workshop.md)
- [Outdated user-guide extract](documentation/user-guide-extract-2019.md)
- [System inventory](technical/system-inventory.md)
- [Interface notes](technical/interface-notes.md)
- [Support observations](operations/support-observations.md)
- [Security review notes](security/review-notes.md)
- [Migration constraints](migration/constraints.md)
- [Decision history](governance/decision-history.md)

This README describes the fixture and is not project source material.

The domain-based structure can later accommodate architecture diagrams, API
documentation, specifications, backlog extracts, release notes, and additional
decision records.
